_comment: Written by the trading runs. impliedMove is a decimal or null. null means the straddle was not pulled - an open checklist item, not a placeholder to guess at. This file is a list of what is AHEAD: the pre-close run prunes catalysts once their date has passed and re-reads spot from a live quote, because a reference price carried from the day it was written makes every implied range wrong.
prunedNote: PRUNED AGAINST A LIVE CALENDAR RE-PULLED FOR 2026-08-24 THROUGH 2026-08-28, AND ALL THREE DUTIES ARE RECORDED AS PERFORMED RATHER THAN SKIPPED. NOTHING WAS REMOVED, because nothing on this file has passed: the single NVDA row is dated 2026-08-26 after the close, TWO sessions ahead, and it was re-verified on this pull as NVDA, 2026-08-26, timing pm, verified true, no actual yet, estimate 2.07 for fiscal Q2 2027. THE CARRIED SPOT WAS REFRESHED FROM A LIVE QUOTE AND THIS TIME THE DRIFT WAS THE LARGEST OF THE THREE. 208.83 bid at 19:36:04.542376527Z against the 215.01 written into this file on 8/21: a fall of 6.18, or 2.87%, in one session. The two refreshes before it moved the same row by exactly 2.20 each - 219.41 to 217.21, then 217.21 to 215.01 - so the row has now come down 10.58 in total, 4.82% from where it was written, and 2.74% of that arrived today alone against a 214.72 settled close. A range implied off the Friday figure would be centred six dollars above the tape and one implied off Wednesday's by more than ten. AMD sat on this board at 522.95 the morning it traded at 486; the case for refreshing as a rule rather than when the drift looks large enough to bother with is this row, three sessions running. THE BRANCHES ARE UNCHANGED AND EVERY ONE STILL CARRIES ITS WHY. The 8/25 to 8/27 span written on 8/21 was re-checked against this pull and still covers both prints: NVDA 2026-08-26 pm and MRVL 2026-08-27 pm, verified, estimate 0.87 for fiscal Q2 2027. No wording gap was found this time. WHAT THIS SESSION ADDS IS THE FIRST TAPE THAT TESTS BRANCH THREE RATHER THAN ADMIRING IT. The complex sold off into the print today: NVDA 208.83 bid and -2.74%, AMD 455.45 bid and -3.76%, MRVL 229.01 bid and -3.39%. Branch three was written six sessions early for exactly this - the complex selling off and a name on this board looking cheap for it - and its answer was decided in advance and does not change now that the condition is real: cheapness ahead of a dated binary is the binary being priced, not a setup, and the first print of a fall is not a support level. Nothing is bought on that basis and the complex is re-approached only from 8/27 on the reaction bar, where item 2 then governs. AMD'S ARITHMETIC IS RE-STATED BECAUSE THE REFRESH MOVED IT THE HELPFUL WAY: one share at 455.45 is 45.13% of a 1009.16 account against the 40% single-name ceiling, DOWN from the 46.74% this row carried on 8/21 but the same refusal - AMD is blocked by an explicit mechanical limit before any view about NVDA reaches it. IMPLIED MOVE STAYS NULL AND STAYS AN OPEN CHECKLIST ITEM RATHER THAN A PLACEHOLDER TO GUESS AT: no straddle was pulled, this board holds nothing into the print, item 3 is owed only before an earnings hold, and a straddle quoted two sessions early measures a different event than the one that will be priced on 8/26. The 8/25 pre-close owns pulling it if anything is open or contemplated by then, and the 8/27 open owns pruning this row. THE BOOK IS FLAT INTO THIS ROW AND NO POSITION IS EXPOSED TO IT, which is the outcome the branches below were written six sessions early to produce.

moves.source: Spot REFRESHED LIVE at 19:36:04.542376527Z on 8/24 by the pre-close run, not carried from the day the row was written: 208.83 bid / 208.84 ask on a 0.005% spread, last trade 208.830, against a 214.72 settled close on 8/21 - down 2.74% on the session and DOWN 2.87% from the 215.01 this row carried from Friday. That is a fall of 6.18, the LARGEST of the three refreshes this row has had and nearly triple either of the first two, which moved it by exactly 2.20 each. Cumulatively the row has come down 10.58 from the 219.41 it was written at - 4.82% - so a row left at the Friday figure would centre its implied range six dollars above the tape. The event was re-verified on a live earnings-calendar pull covering 2026-08-24 to 2026-08-28: NVDA, 2026-08-26, timing pm, verified true, no actual yet, estimate 2.07 for fiscal Q2 2027, TWO sessions ahead. impliedMove is null because NO STRADDLE WAS PULLED - this board holds nothing into the print, item 3 is owed only before an earnings hold, and a straddle quoted two sessions early measures a different event. The 8/25 pre-close owns pulling it if anything is open or contemplated by then. MRVL is recorded here rather than as a second row: re-verified on the same pull as 2026-08-27 after the close, estimate 0.87 for fiscal Q2 2027 - a second dated semiconductor print one session behind NVDA, and the reason branch one spans 8/25 to 8/27. It quotes 229.01 bid, down 3.39% today. AMD is recorded here as the transmission mechanism rather than as a second row, and its arithmetic is unchanged and still prohibitive: 455.45 bid at 19:36:04.080289385Z, DOWN 3.76% on the session, and one share is 45.13% of a 1009.16 account against the 40% single-name ceiling - so AMD is refused by an explicit mechanical limit before any view about NVDA reaches it. THE WHOLE COMPLEX FELL TOGETHER TODAY - NVDA -2.74%, AMD -3.76%, MRVL -3.39% - which is branch three's condition arriving for real two sessions before the print rather than as a hypothetical. The answer was decided in advance and does not move: that is the binary being priced, not a discount to buy.

branches.cond: An entry considered in the AI or semiconductor complex - AMD, SMCI, MRVL, or any sympathy name - on 8/25, 8/26 or 8/27, into either print
branches.act: Refused, decided now rather than on the day
branches.why: The rulebook forbids holding an option through a print outright, and for equity the -8% stop has to survive the event or it is not a stop. This board has already refused SMCI once on exactly that arithmetic - a 14.4% implied move swallows an 8% stop, so the realistic bad case gaps through the exit rather than filling at it. NVDA own move is not the exposure here; the exposure is that a sympathy name carries the index gap without carrying its liquidity, which is the 2026-08-10 finding about four names off one list being one position at four times the size. THE DATE RANGE WAS WIDENED ON 8/21 AND THE REASON IS RECORDED RATHER THAN SMOOTHED OVER. This branch originally read 8/25 or 8/26 and would have been silent on 8/27, when MRVL reports after the close - a second dated semiconductor print the row had not named. The extra day is not a new judgement and changes no arithmetic; the wording was under-inclusive and a live calendar pull found it. Two prints on consecutive evenings also means the complex carries event risk across BOTH nights, so a position opened on 8/26 to trade the NVDA reaction is holding into MRVL, which is the same refusal one day later rather than a clean second entry. Writing the refusal down six sessions early is the point: on 8/26 it would be a view about the report, and today it is a mechanical consequence of a stop that cannot hold.

branches.cond: A position from an unrelated setup is open and running into 8/26
branches.act: The 8/26 pre-close decides it explicitly against this row, and a hold through the print requires the straddle pulled first
branches.why: A name outside the complex is not automatically exposed, and this row must not become a reason to close good positions early on a date that has nothing to do with them. But an NVDA print is the one evening a session where correlation appears in names that showed none for a month, so the hold cannot be passive. Item 3 binds: no straddle pulled means no earnings hold, and that applies to a position held THROUGH the event even when the event belongs to another ticker whose gap it will wear.

branches.cond: The complex sells off into 8/26 and a name on this board looks cheap for it
branches.act: Not bought on that basis, and re-approached only from 8/27 on the reaction bar
branches.why: Cheapness ahead of a dated binary is not a setup - it is the binary being priced, and buying it is taking the event risk the branch above just refused. This is the same reasoning that has kept KLAR unbought through a 22% gap all day: the first print of a fall is not a support level. The post-print session is the first point the rulebook can engage at all, and item 2 then governs - the reaction day is not the entry, the day-2 or day-3 pullback that holds is.
